acceptanceCriteria: The fail-open test proves signalling by an observable (e.g. signal receipt or group ESRCH after the kill) rather than a wall-clock bound; the concurrency test uses barriers to force the critical interleavings through production wait paths; both pass under -race -count=50 on a loaded host.
body: Review findings on V1-0734 (lane-0734, 2026-10-08). P2: cmd/corvint/host_adapter_fail_open_test.go failOpenOutliveBound = 100 * time.Millisecond treats disappearance within 100 ms as proof of signalling, but waitFailOpenOrphans includes test scheduling time, so loaded hosts can fail it. P3: internal/groupreap/live_unix_test.go (around line 204) uses a 20 ms sleep without asserting overlapping starts/releases, and releases manually instead of using production wait paths, so it can pass without exercising the race.

completion.reason: Merged in beamfall/corvint#702 (merge b2a0b8c6): fail-open survival bound scales with stand-in lifetime; groupreap AHI-048 test proves blocked release and start during kill and cleans up on failure; 30x -race and GOMAXPROCS=1 runs pass; independent review findings fixed. Darwin arm64 only.

title: groupreap tests: scheduler-dependent 100 ms bound and a race test that may not race
